title: The Work Orders list, Board View and Tech View show no Bill To
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in Approved, billed to customer B.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work Orders list.
  2. Open Board View.
  3. Open Tech View.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 is listed with customer A as its customer.
  • No "Bill To" column or label shows: customer B is not named.

Step 2:

  • Work order 1's card shows customer A.
  • No "Bill To" shows on the card.

Step 3:

  • No "Bill To" shows anywhere on Tech View.
